findings.title: A solo repository with no remote can never finish the upgrade
findings.detail:
With no git remote every story fails, so doctor's run_state check and the status item keep pointing to norn upgrade until a remote is added. This is consistent with GR6c ('pushes it, and only then stages the removal'). The person may still want to confirm that a remote-less repo is meant to stay that way.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: None needed; optionally have the doctor hint say a remote is required.
